executiveSummary.headline: Make the 700-Guest Event Proposition Consistent and Machine-Usable
executiveSummary.lead: The hotel appears in 19.6% of comparable answers and 41.3% of eligible scenarios, while official pages explicitly support several attributes recorded at 0%. The immediate task is to reconcile explicit first-party facts with the staged reality gaps, while treating technical-probe results as bounded observations rather than causal proof.
